⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Out of This World – An Unforgettable Dining Experience!
Oct 2026 • Couples
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Out of This World – An Unforgettable Dining Experience!

We feel truly honored and immensely privileged to have been part of the “Story of the Bay / Vịnh” dining event at Pavilion Restaurant. 

From the very first moment to the final bite, this culinary experience was simply out of this world.

If we could award 6 stars, we would do so without hesitation!

Culinary Perfection Across Every Course

The food was unlike anything we have ever tasted. Each dish was a masterclass in balance, where intricate aromas, exquisite textures, and harmonious flavours danced across the palate.

Coupled with flawlessly curated wine pairings that elevated every single course, every plate brought something extraordinary:
 
Welcome Bites: A delicate and welcoming start, setting the perfect tone for an extraordinary evening.

Origins – Around the Squid:

A breathtaking play on textures featuring light quenelle, tender poached mantle strips, and crisp tempura tentacle enveloped in a rich, dramatic squid ink emulsion and fragrant lemongrass broth.

The Bay – Local Grouper & Saffron: 
Flawlessly roasted local grouper paired with a delicate saffron fish jus, velvety tomato fondue, and a wonderfully crispy fish skin that provided the most satisfying crunch.

The Island – Hidden Lagoon: 
A comforting, beautifully aromatic clear shellfish consommé delicately infused with pandan and kaffir lime, poured tableside with ultimate precision.

The Land – Hai Ha Wild Duck: 
Remarkably rich and succulent slow-roasted duck breast alongside spiced confit leg, offset by a vibrant carrot and ginger cream and a perfectly balanced mountain pepper sauce.

The Craft – Lamb with Artichoke & Black Garlic:

Melt-in-the-mouth roasted lamb loin complemented by the depth of black garlic, rich smoked eggplant, and a silky rosemary jus.

The Pearl – Pearl of Vietnam: 
A stunning visual and culinary masterpiece. The delicate coconut custard pearl infused with cardamom and cinnamon, surrounded by fresh tropical fruit and topped with a brilliant green dome, was a pure triumph to conclude the meal.

World-Class Culinary Talent & Outstanding Service
A huge, heartfelt special mention must go to the 3 amazing Chefs. Their incredible talent, unmatched skills, and pure passion for creating such an imaginative, world-class menu place them truly in a league of their own.

The front-of-house staff were equally outstanding.
A very special thank you to Ling & Son, who looked after us exceptionally well throughout the entire evening. Their warm hospitality, flawless attention to detail, and captivating storytelling for each dish, explaining the deep history and inspiration behind every course was utterly breathtaking.

Thank you to the whole team at Pavilion at the Vinpearl for an unforgettable evening. 

Amazing value!

We feel so lucky to have experienced this event!
